# New Home Warranty HQ

> Homeowner-controlled software for documenting new-home builder-warranty issues, sending the requests you approve to your builder, tracking replies, appointments and repairs, and getting reminders before your confirmed coverage windows end. It is not a home warranty, insurance policy, insurer, or law firm.

Site: https://newhomewarrantyhq.com/
Pricing: $189 one-time for homeowners (no subscription; 30-day satisfaction guarantee). Partner gift price: $124 one-time, bought by realtors, lenders, title companies, inspectors and other approved partners for their new-construction clients.

## What it does

- Document defects with photos and notes during the builder warranty period
- Draft warranty requests that you write or approve; the app emails them to your builder and logs the builder's replies in your dashboard
- Track status, appointments and repairs until items are fixed
- Reminders 60 and 14 days before each coverage window you confirm ends
- Partner gifts: a partner can buy the product at $124 for a client, who receives an email to set up their own account

## Important distinctions

- A builder warranty (the builder's workmanship, systems and structural coverage) is different from a "home warranty" service contract sold by insurers
- New Home Warranty HQ does not provide warranty coverage, pay for repairs, or decide whether an issue is covered; that is decided by the builder or warranty provider
- It does not give legal advice
- Partners who gift the product cannot see the homeowner's issues
